      + user_data                            = <<-EOT
            #!/bin/bash
            # Boot script for the bench instance (rendered by Terraform): fio for the EBS tests, boto3 for
            # the S3 tests, and the bench agent that both run through SSM.
            set -euxo pipefail
            dnf install -y fio
            dnf install -y python3-boto3 || echo "python3-boto3 not installed - the S3 tests will report it"
            mkdir -p /opt/bench /var/tmp/bench
            echo '' | base64 -d | gunzip > /opt/bench/bench_agent.py
            chmod 755 /opt/bench/bench_agent.py
            fio --version
            python3 -c 'import boto3; print("boto3", boto3.__version__)' || true
            touch /var/tmp/bench/ready
            echo "bench ready"
        EOT
